why_this_data.value: High-energy transitions trace the compact disk

evidence.quote: Zapata et al. (2015) noted that high-energy transitions (E u ≥ 500 K) seem to trace mostly the compact disk.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Two offset non-Keplerian rings in CS rejected since the enclosed mass of the outer ring should be larger

evidence.quote: so the inner disk radius found in the model could be due only to opacity effects.
